specification.problem: Perfect state transfer (PST) between antipodal nodes of a discrete-time quantum walk (DTQW) on a modified cycle graph, here the tiny case C4 with a generic coin. The abstract's specific modifications, coin choices and graph families are not given.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Background-only DTQW on the unmodified cycle C4 (N=4) with a Grover coin, testing PST from node 0 to antipodal node 2 via fidelity. Outside scope: the specific modifications of C4/C6/C8, the three coin choices, the three generalised graph families, continuous-time walks, robustness tests (initial state variation, interpolation, decoherence).

symbols.meaning: walker at node v with coin/arc label c

symbols.domain: 2x2 unitary acting on the coin space

symbols.meaning: probability of finding the walker at the target node after t steps

equations.label: Walk operator
equations.description: One step of coined DTQW on the cycle: coin then shift, with c=0 moving forward and c=1 backward.
equations.justification: Standard DTQW definition on a cycle; the abstract's modified graphs are not specified.

equations.label: Grover coin
equations.description: The 2x2 Grover coin 2|s><s|-I with s uniform, which equals the Pauli X matrix.
equations.justification: One example coin chosen as an assumption; the abstract's three coins are not named.
assumptions: Grover coin on a degree-2 vertex

equations.label: State evolution
equations.description: Evolution from an assumed localized initial state at node 0.
equations.justification: Concrete initial condition chosen for the tiny instance; the abstract mentions initial conditions only generally.

equations.label: Antipodal transfer fidelity
equations.description: Probability at the antipodal node 2 for N=4 after t steps.
equations.abstract_quote: perfect state transfer between antipodal nodes of discrete time quantum walks
equations.justification: Inferred: PST between antipodal nodes means F_t=1 at some t; the exact definition used by the paper (e.g. including fixed coin state) is unknown.
assumptions: Coin state ignored at the target

equations.label: PST criterion
equations.description: Perfect state transfer occurs when the fidelity at the antipode reaches exactly 1.
equations.abstract_quote: Perfect state transfer was found, in general, to be very rare
equations.justification: Inferred from the notion of PST as exact unit transfer probability; numerical tolerance is not in the abstract.

registers.name: position
registers.role: node label v in Z_4, binary encoded with v=2q1+q0

registers.name: coin
registers.role: arc direction c; ordering: position register first, then coin

steps.description: Prepare the initial state at node 0 with coin |0>.
Apply the coin C to the coin register, then the conditional shift S, and repeat t times.
Compute the antipodal fidelity F_t for each t and check the PST criterion.

specification.measurement: Measure the position register in the computational basis after t steps; estimate the probability of node 2.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Compare the estimated F_t with 1 over a range of t to detect PST or high-fidelity transfer.
assumptions: Unmodified C4 used as the smallest instance
Grover coin (Pauli X) and initial state |0,0> are chosen for illustration, not taken from the abstract
missing_information: Actual modifications of C4, C6, C8 (added edges, loops, weights)
Definitions of the three graph families
